title: X-World 1.6: Building Controllable Virtual Cities with World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.00596v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deploying generative world models for end-to-end closed-loop evaluation and policy learning requires precise scenario control, consistent observations, and sustained generation quality during extended interactions. This report presents X-World 1.6, advancing X-World 1.0 toward a more reliable and versatile driving simulator. The upgraded base model offers finer-grained control over traffic semantics, including traffic lights and road markings, together with improved spatial consistency across cameras. Virtual City capabilities broaden scenario construction through a family of models conditioned on diverse 2D and 3D references, including support for generating multi-camera future videos from a single image. An enhanced post-training framework enables efficient causal, few-step generation with stronger temporal coherence, better quality retention over longer rollouts, and improved alignment with human preferences. translated_title: X-World 1.6：基于世界模型构建可控虚拟城市
translated_abstract: 将生成式世界模型部署用于端到端闭环评估与策略学习，需要在长时间交互过程中具备精确的场景控制、一致的观测结果以及持续稳定的生成质量。本报告介绍X-World 1.6，它是对X-World 1.0的升级，朝着更可靠、更通用的驾驶模拟器迈进。升级后的基础模型对交通语义（包括交通灯和道路标线）提供了更细粒度的控制，并提升了多摄像头之间的空间一致性。虚拟城市能力通过一系列以多种2D和3D参考为条件的模型扩展了场景构建方式，包括支持从单张图像生成多摄像头未来视频。增强的后训练框架实现了高效的因果式少步数生成，具有更强的时间连贯性、在更长时序推演中更好的质量保持，以及与人类偏好更好的对齐。我们还引入了一个……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: X-World 1.6是一个更可靠、更通用的驾驶世界模型模拟器，其核心创新在于实现细粒度交通语义控制与多摄像头空间一致性、支持从单张图像及多样化2D/3D参考构建虚拟城市场景，并通过高效少步数生成的后训练框架保障长时间闭环评估中的生成质量。
en_tdlr: X-World 1.6 advances world-model-based driving simulation with finer-grained traffic semantic control, improved multi-camera consistency, virtual city construction from single images and diverse 2D/3D references, and an efficient few-step post-training framework for reliable long-horizon closed-loop evaluation and policy learning.
